terms.comment: Traupman gives tata for “granddad” as well as “dad”, but Lewis & Short know it only as a child’s word for father and, in Martial, for the man who brought one up. Say avus.

phrases.latin: avum cōnspicātus in complexum ejus cucurrit, «Ave! Ave!» clāmāns
phrases.english: he saw Grandpa and ran into his arms, shouting “Grandpa! Grandpa!”
phrases.source: Libellus II, Sintra: castellum et puteus

sources: The grouped card gave no source for this word.
